blocking: The visual identity is recognizable, but the interior page rhythm and mobile typography are not yet polished enough for launch sign-off.
The mobile founder quote loses excessive reading width through cumulative right padding.

fixes.what: Remove the additional 40px right padding from the quote; retain one shared clearance for the persistent tab and center the quote within that usable area.
fixes.why: At 390px, cumulative padding squeezes the quote into roughly 246px and makes the composition visibly lopsided.

fixes.what: Reduce the combined spacing between the promises and celebrations; use approximately 64–80px between sections and 24–32px between headings and their content.
fixes.why: The desktop capture has a large empty interval that disconnects the promises from the next visual chapter.

fixes.what: Keep the two service options as the homepage summary and move their detailed responsibility lists to how-we-work.html; remove the overlapping Plan and Run the day cards.
fixes.why: Repeated service explanations turn the middle of the homepage into a dense brochure and weaken the editorial pacing.

fixes.what: Remove the three repeated top borders, reduce horizontal card padding, and use the gold numbering with generous whitespace to organize the promises.
fixes.why: The repeated ruled columns feel like a generic service grid rather than the distinctive painted-tree and kashida identity.

fixes.what: Keep TT Ramillas Bold, but use sentence case, less tracking, and a 14px mobile size; separate the Bay Area location onto its own short line.
fixes.why: The small all-caps descriptor reads like fine print beneath a strong, readable logo.

fixes.what: Present the celebration names as an unboxed typographic list with generous gaps instead of gold-outlined capsules.
